property_summary: The requestPrice function can only be invoked by the optimisticAsserter; in the reference implementation, any call from a non-optimisticAsserter address reverts, preventing the PriceRequestAdded event from being emitted, whereas the buggy version allows any caller to emit the event.
change_summary: Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier so requestPrice can be called by anyone, changing when PriceRequestAdded is emitted.
